quality_guards: Annual landlord gas safety checks do not replace effective maintenance.
Gas duties depend on appliance, flue, pipework and ownership boundaries.
LPG zoning and supplier/user duties depend on installation design and contractual responsibility.
Underground-service plans do not prove exact live position or depth and locators must be used repeatedly.
Excavation stability and support require reinspection when conditions change.
Demolition methods, exclusion zones and temporary supports are structure- and phase-specific.
A standard scaffold is not building restraint unless specifically designed for that purpose.
Confined-space atmospheres can change and rescue cannot rely only on public emergency services.
Vehicle load security requires checks during the journey because restraints and loads can change.
The DVSA code assists compliance but enforcement uses defect categorisation and case circumstances.
CAA laser incident counts on the safety-plan page are historical rather than a live feed.
A laser occurrence report does not by itself establish legal responsibility or medical outcome.
Small-vessel code transition and equipment depend on certification, vessel category, voyage and dates.
Radiation protective action is location- and incident-specific and official advice can change.
DSEAR physical-safety controls do not replace separate health-risk controls such as COSHH.
Flammable-liquid controls depend on quantity, temperature, storage form, work process and actual risk.
Official-source context is not converted into exact parcel-level probability.
Live 130-candidate/16-endpoint parity, browser DOM/console acceptance and publisher remote readback remain required.
No second runner was started; the stale single-runner recovery blocker remains OPEN.
